study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modelling of brain function abnormalities in complex pathology needs the whole brain

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We use rsfMRI data from UKB ( N >60,000 people)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy subjects for normative model training (N=32,000) and testing (N=14,000); BD (N=101) and PD (N=132) subjects for disease evaluation.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: We divide the subjects into three groups: A large group of healthy subjects to train the model on (training data, N =32,000), a set of healthy subjects on which we test the out-of-sample performance of the model (test data, N =14,000), and a group of subjects with psychiatric or neurological diagnoses. We focused on chronic brain diseases that have been addressed in the rsfMRI FC literature 4 and that have more than 100 subjects in the dataset: BD ( N =101) and PD ( N =132).

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Training healthy subjects N=32,000; test healthy subjects N=14,000.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: We divide the subjects into three groups: A large group of healthy subjects to train the model on (training data, N =32,000), a set of healthy subjects on which we test the out-of-sample performance of the model (test data, N =14,000)
